title: ICSB Chartered Secretary Qualification
body: The Institute of Chartered Secretaries of Bangladesh
source: Chartered Secretaries Act 2010 & ICSB Curriculum Handbook
summary: ICSB confers the statutory ACS and FCS designations under the Chartered Secretaries Act, 2010. Governs company secretarial practice, statutory corporate governance, secretarial audit, and BSEC compliance across 19 papers and 3 years practical experience.

primaryPowers: Exclusive statutory professional authority for Chartered Secretaries in Bangladesh
Statutory Corporate Governance Compliance Certification under BSEC CGC 2018 Cond. 1(5)(xxvii)
Mandatory listed company Company Secretary qualification under BSEC Listing Regulations
Standard-setter for Bangladesh Secretarial Standards (BSS-1 through BSS-6)
Secretarial Audit and legal due diligence execution

standard.name: Standard CS Track
standard.blurb: Complete all levels (Foundation to Professional-II), Case Study, and 3 years verified experience for ACS.

stages.title: Tier 1: Foundation Level
stages.subtitle: 4 Papers (400 Marks) | Entry core business fundamentals

nodes.name: Business Communication
nodes.description: Corporate drafting, board meeting notices, executive correspondence, and professional communications.
topics: Principles of Written Business Communication & 7 Cs Framework
Corporate Drafting: Letters, Memoranda, Agendas & Executive Briefings
Report Writing: Committee Reports, Fact-Finding Reports & Chairman's Speeches
Verbal & Non-Verbal Business Kinesics, Boardroom Presentation Skills & Etiquette

nodes.name: Business Economics & Statistics
nodes.description: Micro/macroeconomics, market structures, central tendency, regression, and sampling statistics.
topics: Microeconomics: Demand-Supply Laws, Elasticities & Market Structures
Macroeconomic Indicators: National Income, Inflation & Monetary Policy
Descriptive Statistics: Central Tendency, Dispersion & Index Numbers
Inferential Statistics: Correlation, Simple Regression & Sampling Methods

nodes.name: Fundamentals of Accounting & Auditing
nodes.description: Basic double-entry accounting, trial balance, financial statements, and auditing fundamentals.
topics: Double-Entry Bookkeeping Principles, Journal, Ledger & Trial Balance
Preparation of Financial Statements for Sole Traders & Partnerships
Auditing Concepts: Objectives, Scope & Auditor Independence
Internal Control Systems, Internal Check & Audit Evidence Gathering

nodes.name: Business Management, Ethics & Entrepreneurship
nodes.description: Principles of management, corporate ethics, CSR governance, and entrepreneurial ventures.
topics: Principles of Management, Planning & Organizational Hierarchy Design
Business Ethics: Corporate Moral Codes, Integrity & Resolving Dilemmas
Corporate Social Responsibility (CSR) & Stakeholder Engagement Policies
Entrepreneurship: Business Opportunity Evaluation, Funding & Business Plans

stages.title: Tier 2: Certificate Level - I
stages.subtitle: 3 Papers (300 Marks) | Labor laws, commercial jurisprudence & corporate accounting

nodes.name: HRM & Industrial Relations
nodes.description: HR planning, Bangladesh Labor Act 2006 compliance, trade unions, health and safety, and industrial dispute arbitration.
topics: Human Resource Planning, Recruitment, Talent Selection & Onboarding
Performance Appraisal Systems, Compensation & Employee Retention Strategies
Bangladesh Labor Act 2006: Employment Conditions, Working Hours & Leaves
Industrial Relations: Trade Unions, Collective Bargaining Agents & Labor Courts

nodes.name: General & Commercial Laws
nodes.description: Contract Act 1872, Sale of Goods 1930, Negotiable Instruments 1881, and Transfer of Property 1882.
topics: Contract Act 1872: Formation, Consideration, Free Consent & Breach Remedies
Sale of Goods Act 1930: Conditions, Warranties & Rights of Unpaid Sellers
Negotiable Instruments Act 1881: Cheques, Bills of Exchange & Sec 138 Dishonor
Commercial Laws: Transfer of Property, Specific Relief & Commercial Arbitration

nodes.name: Corporate Accounting & Valuation
nodes.description: Corporate share/debenture issuance, corporate financial statement drafting under IFRS, and business valuation models.
topics: Corporate Share Capital: Issuance, Forfeiture, Reissue & Debentures
Preparation of Corporate Financial Statements under IFRS/IAS
Equity & Business Valuation: NAV Method, Yield Capitalization & DCF Modeling
Accounting for Corporate Amalgamations, Mergers & Internal Capital Restructuring

stages.title: Tier 3: Certificate Level - II
stages.subtitle: 3 Papers (300 Marks) | Secretarial drafting, taxation & corporate IT systems

nodes.name: Corporate Communication & Report Writing
nodes.description: Drafting board minutes, directors' report narratives, corporate circulars, and annual governance disclosures.
topics: Drafting Minutes of Board of Directors & Specialized Committee Meetings
Drafting Annual Report Disclosures, Directors' Report & MD&A Narratives
Price Sensitive Information (PSI) Notices & Disclosures to DSE/CSE/BSEC
Secretarial Correspondence with Regulatory Agencies (RJSC, BSEC, NBR)

nodes.name: Direct & Indirect Tax Laws
nodes.description: Income Tax Act 2023, corporate tax compliance, TDS obligations of the Company Secretary, and VAT Act 2012.
topics: Income Tax Act 2023: Corporate Tax Principles & Allowable Deductions
Tax Deducted at Source (TDS): Company Secretary Withholding Responsibilities
VAT & Supplementary Duty Act 2012: Invoicing (Mushak 6.3) & Withholding (VDS)
Customs Law Fundamentals, Import Tariffs & Bonded Warehouse Regulations

nodes.name: Information Technology Application in Business
nodes.description: Corporate database administration, ERP integration, e-governance filings, and cyber law security protocols.
topics: Enterprise Systems in Governance: ERP Integration & Digital Archiving
E-Governance & Regulatory Portals: RJSC Online Filings & Digital Signatures
Information & Communication Technology (ICT) Act 2006 & Cyber Law Standards
IT Security Governance, Access Controls & Business Continuity Planning (BCP)

stages.title: Tier 4: Certificate Level - III
stages.subtitle: 4 Papers (400 Marks) | Core company law, secretarial practice & financial institutions

nodes.name: Company Law & Practice
nodes.description: Comprehensive Companies Act 1994, Memorandum & Articles, share transfer mechanics, and RJSC statutory filings.
topics: Companies Act 1994: Company Types, Incorporation & Memorandum/Articles Alteration
Prospectus, Capital Raising, Share Transfers & Registration of Charges with RJSC
Directors' Appointments, Disqualifications, Board Quorum & Remuneration
Statutory Registers: Register of Members, Directors & Charges Maintenance
Mandatory Filings with RJSC: Form IX, Form XII, Form X, Schedule X & Form XVIII

nodes.name: Company Secretarial Practice
nodes.description: Role of the Company Secretary, Board administration, AGM/EGM management, and Bangladesh Secretarial Standards (BSS 1-6).
topics: Role, Statutory Duties & Legal Liabilities of the Practicing Company Secretary
BSS-1 (Meetings of the Board of Directors) & BSS-2 (General Meetings - AGM/EGM)
BSS-3 (Minutes Recording Protocols) & BSS-4 (Dividend Declaration & CMSF Rules)
BSS-5 (Electronic Virtual Meetings) & BSS-6 (Board Resolutions by Circulation)
Organizing Shareholder Meetings: Statutory 21-Day Notices, Proxies & E-Voting

nodes.name: Interpreting Financial & Accounting Information
nodes.description: Financial ratio analysis, cash flow evaluation, notes interpretation, and audit report governance oversight.
topics: Comprehensive Analysis of Published Corporate Annual Reports & Statements
Financial Ratio Diagnostics: Liquidity, Solvency, Debt Service & ROCE
Interpreting Independent Auditor's Reports: Unqualified Opinions, KAMs & Notes
Corporate Solvency Evaluation, Cash Flow Vitality (IAS 7) & Risk Oversight

nodes.name: Banking, NBFI & Insurance Laws & Practice
nodes.description: Bank Company Act 1991, NBFI regulations, and Insurance Act 2010 corporate governance requirements.
topics: Bank Company Act 1991: Licensing, Capital Requirements & Governance Restrictions
Financial Institutions Act 1993: NBFI Licensing, Debt Recovery & Regulations
Money Loan Court Act 2003 (Artha Rin Adalat Ain): Suits, Decrees & Auctions
Insurance Act 2010: IDRA Guidelines, Solvency Margins & Policyholder Protection

stages.title: Tier 5: Professional Level - I
stages.subtitle: 4 Papers (400 Marks) | Corporate restructuring, finance strategy, governance & advanced tax

nodes.name: Advanced Company Law & Corporate Restructuring
nodes.description: Mergers, acquisitions, demergers, High Court schemes of arrangement (Sec 228/229), and insolvency winding-up.
topics: Corporate Restructuring Schemes under Companies Act 1994 Sections 228 & 229
High Court Sanction Process: Petitions, Creditor/Shareholder Meetings & Filings
Reduction of Share Capital under Sections 59–70 & Special Resolution Procedures
Prevention of Minority Oppression & Mismanagement under Section 233
Corporate Winding-Up Modes: Court Compulsory vs. Voluntary Winding-Up & Liquidators

nodes.name: Corporate Financial Management
nodes.description: Long-term corporate capital financing, capital budgeting under uncertainty, and corporate dividend strategy.
topics: Strategic Capital Budgeting: Discounted Cash Flow (NPV, IRR) & Risk Evaluation
Cost of Capital Estimation (WACC) & Optimal Corporate Capital Structure
Dividend Policy Models, Legal Distributable Profits & Share Buybacks
Long-Term Debt Financing: Syndicated Bank Loans, Corporate Bonds & Sukuk

nodes.name: Corporate Governance & Risk Management
nodes.description: BSEC Corporate Governance Code (CGC 2018), Independent Directors, Board evaluation, and COSO ERM risk frameworks.
topics: BSEC Corporate Governance Code (CGC 2018): Comprehensive Clause Analysis
Independent Directors: Eligibility, Fiduciary Duties & Board Diversity
Audit Committee & Nomination and Remuneration Committee (NRC) Mandates
Enterprise Risk Management (ERM): COSO Framework, Risk Appetite & Registers
Internal Controls Oversight, Whistleblower Systems & Corporate Ethics

nodes.name: Advanced Taxation Practice
nodes.description: Strategic corporate tax planning, transfer pricing documentation, DTAA, and Taxes Appellate Tribunal proceedings.
topics: Strategic Corporate Tax Planning & Tax-Free Reorganizations in Bangladesh
International Tax Treaties (DTAA) & Transfer Pricing Arm's Length Compliance
Tax Appellate Litigation: Appeals before Commissioner (Appeals) & Tribunal
Alternative Dispute Resolution (ADR) Procedures under Income Tax & VAT Acts

stages.title: Tier 6: Professional Level - II & Practicum
stages.subtitle: 4 Papers (400 Marks) + 36 Months Practical Experience | Statutory secretarial audit, capital market & board advisory

nodes.name: Corporate Secretaryship
nodes.description: Senior board advisory, joint venture structuring, statutory representation before BSEC/RJSC/FRC, and corporate dispute resolution.
topics: High-Level Board Advisory: Board Politics, Conflicts of Interest & D&O Insurance
Drafting Joint Venture Agreements, Shareholder Pacts & Technology Transfers
Statutory Representation before RJSC, BSEC, DSE, CSE, Bangladesh Bank & FRC
ESG Governance Architecture, Sustainability Disclosures & Corporate Transparency

nodes.name: Strategic & Operations Management
nodes.description: Strategic leadership, environmental scanning, TQM, ISO quality governance, and operational transformation.
topics: Enterprise Strategic Planning: PESTEL, Porter's Five Forces & Core Competencies
Strategy Execution Models, Balanced Scorecards & Structural Alignment
Operations Management: Total Quality Management (TQM) & ISO 9001/27001 Standards
Corporate Crisis Leadership: Emergency Communications, Hostile Defense & Media

nodes.name: Securities Laws & Capital Market
nodes.description: Securities & Exchange Ordinance 1969, BSEC regulations, DSE/CSE listing rules, CDBL depository by-laws, and IPO regulations.
topics: Securities and Exchange Ordinance 1969 & BSEC Act 1993: Prohibitions & Penalties
BSEC Public Issue Rules: IPO Process, Book Building, Underwriting & Prospectuses
DSE & CSE Listing Regulations: Continuous Disclosures & Material Events (PSI)
Central Depository Bangladesh Ltd (CDBL) Rules: Dematerialization & BO Accounts
Substantial Acquisition of Shares, Open Offer Thresholds & Takeover Code

nodes.name: Compliance Management, Secretarial Audit & Due Diligence
nodes.description: Statutory Secretarial Audit execution, BSEC CGC 2018 compliance certification, legal due diligence for IPOs and M&A.
topics: Statutory Secretarial Audit: Framework, Audit Scope & Working Paper Standards
BSEC Corporate Governance Compliance Certification under CGC 2018 Condition 1(5)
Comprehensive Annexure-C Compliance Checklist Verification Methodology
Legal Due Diligence: Verification of Corporate Title, Licenses, Contracts & Litigation
Drafting Secretarial Audit Reports, Adverse Findings & Management Representations

nodes.name: Practical Secretarial Experience (36 Months)
nodes.description: 3 years verified relevant corporate secretarial, legal, finance, or governance experience required for ACS membership.
topics: 36 Months Practical Experience in Company Secretarial, Legal or Governance Roles
Drafting Corporate Board Documentation, Minutes & RJSC Statutory Returns
Advising on BSEC Corporate Governance Code Adherence & Compliance Checklists
Participation in Secretarial Audit Engagements & Due Diligence Reviews
Submission of Verified Experience Portfolio & Secretarial Internship Report

fast-track-accountants.name: Professional Accountants Fast-Track Route
fast-track-accountants.blurb: Receive 100% waiver from Foundation Level + exemptions in accounting & tax papers; focus entirely on statutory Company Law, Governance, Secretarial Audit, and Securities Law.

nodes.description: Verification of membership in ICAB, ICMAB, or ACCA. Automatic 100% waiver of Foundation Level and exemptions in Papers 103, 202, and 303.
